workflows.pr-title.yml:
name: PR Title

# The repository squash-merges. GitHub's default squash title here is "commit
# or PR title": a single-commit PR merges under its commit's subject, a
# multi-commit PR under the PR title, and either becomes the `main` commit
# that svu versions and the GoReleaser changelog groups by. So the PR title
# must be a Conventional Commit, and when there is exactly one commit that
# commit's subject must be too (see AGENTS.md "Commits & Pull Requests").
# `Conventional PR title` is a required check, so it must also report on the
# merge queue's own check requests (frostyard/core ADR-0042). There is no
# pull-request title to lint there, so the lint step below is skipped and the
# job succeeds; excluding the job with a job-level `if` would leave the
# required check unreported and stall the queue.
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited, synchronize, reopened]
  merge_group:

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  # `github.event.pull_request.number` is empty on a merge-queue event, so
  # fall back to the ref to keep one group per queue entry.
  group: pr-title-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # (job bodies trimmed; only the uses: lines are kept)
        uses: amannn/action-semantic-pull-request@2252a14e810aa9b85c2d560bd7070c802206ecf6 # v6.1.2

workflows.risk-paths.yml:
# Risk paths (frostyard/core ADR-0068, docs/specs/risk-paths.md): runs core's
# reusable risk-paths workflow on every pull request. A pull request that
# touches a glob in .github/risk-paths.json gets the label risk:high.
#
# The labeler runs in this workflow before risk-paths because actions/labeler
# reads the current labels and then sets the whole label list. A label that
# another job adds between that read and that write is lost (updex#483:
# risk:high added at 19:36:25Z, removed at 19:36:26Z). So within a run the
# risk-paths job runs after the label job, and the concurrency group runs at
# most 1 run per pull request at a time (no cancel: a queued run waits), so the
# label job of a later run never overlaps the risk-paths job of an earlier one.
# Do not add another workflow that sets pull-request labels.
#
# pull_request_target runs this file and the list from the base branch, so a
# pull request cannot remove its own label by an edit of either one. The
# reusable workflow checks out nothing and runs no pull-request code.
# Pinned to a full core commit SHA (ADR-0021). No merge_group trigger, and
# not a required check.
name: Risk paths

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited]

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: risk-paths-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  # (job bodies trimmed; only the uses: lines are kept)
        uses: actions/labeler@bf12e9b00b37c5c0ca2b87b79b2daf7891dbda13 # v7
    uses: frostyard/core/.github/workflows/risk-paths.yml@1b02a129026329cef2b46d1fbd0465a863c1cd81 # core#194
